title: Training Feasibility Assessment — Fine-tuning & LoRA on Each GPU
description: Assess training/fine-tuning capability for each GPU in the comparison set. This is a secondary but important criterion since the user may want to fine-tune models, not just run inference. For each GPU, evaluate: (1) Can it fit a full fine-tune of a 35B model? (FP16 requires ~140GB, LoRA requires ~16-24GB), (2) Can it run QLoRA (4-bit) fine-tuning? (requires ~10-14GB VRAM), (3) Training throughput: tokens/sec during LoRA fine-tuning, (4) Maximum feasible model size for full fine-tune vs LoRA vs QLoRA, (5) Framework support: PEFT/LoRA via HuggingFace, Axolotl, Unsloth, FlashAttention-2 compatibility, (6) Multi-GPU scaling: if the user adds a second GPU, what is the scaling efficiency (NCCL, NVLink vs PCIe), (7) Time-to-train estimates for common tasks: instruction tuning (10K samples), domain adaptation (100K samples), (8) Known limitations: VRAM fragmentation, driver issues, framework bugs on specific hardware. Cross-reference with published training benchmarks and community reports (Reddit r/localLLaMA, HuggingFace forums, GitHub issues).
outputs: per-GPU training feasibility matrix (full FT / LoRA / QLoRA)
